channel.title: Georgia Public Broadcasting - Article Feed
channel.description: Latest articles from Georgia Public Broadcasting (gpb.org)

item.title: Secretly rewritten nuclear safety rules are made public
item.description: The Energy Department made the rules public a month after NPR reported about their existence. The rules slash requirements for security and environmental protections.

item.title: Deadline looms as Anthropic rejects Pentagon demands it remove AI safeguards
item.description: The Defense Department has been feuding with Anthropic over military uses of its artificial intelligence tools. At stake are hundreds of millions of dollars in contracts and access to some of the most advanced AI on the planet.

item.title: Why it's a bit surprising that the U.S. is attending a key global flu meeting
item.description: After the U.S. withdrew from the World Health Organization, it wasn't clear they would participate in this WHO-led meeting to determine the recipe for the next flu vaccine.

item.title: NASA lost a lunar spacecraft one day after launch. A new report details what went wrong
item.description: Why did a $72 million mission to study water on the moon fail so soon after launch? A new NASA report has the answer.

item.title: In reversal, Warner Bros. jilts Netflix for Paramount
item.description: Warner Bros. says Paramount's sweetened bid to buy the whole company is "superior" to an $83 billion deal it struck with Netflix for just its streaming services, studios, and intellectual property.

item.title: Mortgage rates fall below 6% for the first time in years
item.description: The average home loan rate has dropped below 6% for the first time since 2022. Will that help thaw the frozen housing market?

item.title: Can't get a prescription renewed? Here's how to cope with prior authorizations
item.description: These health care hurdles can stand in the way of getting treatment your doctor says you need. Here's what to know about how to deal with them.

item.title: Columbia student detained by ICE is abruptly released after Mamdani meets with Trump
item.description: Hours after the student was taken into custody in her campus apartment, she was released, after New York City Mayor Zohran Mamdani expressed concerns about the arrest to President Trump.

item.title: Pakistan's defense minister says that there is now 'open war' with Afghanistan after latest strikes
item.description: Pakistan's defense minister said that his country ran out of "patience" and considers that there is now an "open war" with Afghanistan, after both countries launched strikes following an Afghan cross-border attack.

item.title: US military used laser to take down Border Protection drone, lawmakers say
item.description: The U.S. military used a laser to shoot down a Customs and Border Protection drone, members of Congress said Thursday, and the Federal Aviation Administration responded by closing more airspace near El Paso, Texas.
